cmdProject: pick a project by number or name
cmdNew: the next message starts a new chat
cmdMode: permissions: ask (risky actions are declined) / edits / full access
cmdStatus: what's selected and whether a task is running
notConfigured: Save the bot token and your chat id above first
title: Telegram remote control
warning: Messages to the bot run Claude on this computer with the selected permissions ("allow edits" by default) while Claude Desk is open. The bot only obeys the configured chat id and ignores all other messages.
helpText: Turn on the switch and send the bot a task in plain text. Claude will run it in the selected project and send back the answer. Each run is saved as a regular chat and shows up in the list on the left.
